assemblies.name: Field receiver
assemblies.desc: A planar antenna fits inside the lid. Its flush status window tracks field intensity.

assemblies.name: Specimen display
assemblies.desc: A flush display shows vitality, toxicity, growth and absorption. Three touch keys sit on the flat front.

assemblies.name: Signal processor
assemblies.desc: A removable board converts samples into readings. Chips, memory and filters sit on a plated carrier.

assemblies.name: Audio emitter
assemblies.desc: A perforated bronze grille protects the circular speaker. The driver and magnet sit behind the flush perforated cover.

assemblies.name: Power cell
assemblies.desc: A removable cell powers the receiver and display. Its alloy strap holds the sealed cell inside the chassis.

assemblies.name: Containment chassis
assemblies.desc: Six square faces form a 120 mm cube. The flat base supports rails, the power cell and corner mounts.
